plan.title: bug(test,windows): Vitest coverage ENOENT on coverage/.tmp mid-suite fails task check after green tests

narratives.Description: On native Windows, Vitest coverage runs can fail with ENOENT on coverage/.tmp/coverage-N.json after a green suite. Ensure the tmp dir exists, serialize coverage processing on win32, and tolerate late ENOENT without soft-failing real coverage gate failures.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

During release `task check` on Windows, Vitest can report tests green then exit non-zero:

```
Unhandled Rejection
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '...\\coverage\\.tmp\\coverage-0.json'
```

Adjacent to #2546 (onTaskUpdate RPC) and #2556 (build-dist archiver race) but distinct: the coverage reporter/worker loses `coverage/.tmp` mid-suite under parallel load.

## Operator-locked decision (c)

BOTH ensure `coverage/.tmp` exists + tolerate late ENOENT AND reduce/serialize coverage workers on win32. Do NOT soft-fail the coverage gate when the suite is green.

## Expected

- `coverage/.tmp` is created before workers write chunks
- win32 coverage runs serialize processing workers
- Green suite + valid coverage thresholds exit zero
- Coverage threshold failures still fail closed
narratives.Labels: bug, test-debt, runtime-portability, blocks-release-tag, ci-cd, area:release
narratives.UserStory: As a Windows maintainer, I want task check coverage runs to finish when tests are green, so that release Step 5 is not blocked by coverage/.tmp ENOENT races.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Extend vitest.config.ts: win32 coverage processingConcurrency=1, tighter worker caps when --coverage, globalSetup to mkdir coverage/.tmp.
2. Add win32-coverage-tmp-setup globalSetup module that keeps .tmp present and swallows late ENOENT on coverage chunk paths only.
3. Extend vitest-config-contract.test.ts with #2580 regression guards.
4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry.
narratives.Acceptance:
1. coverage/.tmp exists before coverage workers write
2. win32 serializes/reduces coverage workers
3. No coverage soft-fail when suite is green
4. Contract tests guard the mitigation
5. CHANGELOG updated

narrative.Acceptance: Given a win32 coverage run, when workers start, then coverage/.tmp already exists via globalSetup.
Given vitest.config.ts on win32 with --coverage, when loaded, then coverage.processingConcurrency is 1 and worker caps are reduced.

items.title: No coverage soft-fail on green suite

narrative.Acceptance: Given a green suite with passing thresholds, when coverage completes, then exit code is zero; threshold failures still exit non-zero.
Given vitest-config-contract.test.ts, when #2580 settings are removed, then focused tests fail.
